canonicalJson.integers: JSON safe integers only; reject numeric strings, floats, exponent notation, -0, and unsafe integers
canonicalJson.objects: plain objects only; reject duplicate and unknown keys

digestDomains.contractSha256: SHA-256 of exact complete LF-terminated schema bytes; schema contains no self hash
digestDomains.idempotencyKeySha256: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 idempotency value; no LF and no normalization
digestDomains.permissionDigest: SHA-256 of shared canonical unsigned-UTF-8-key-ordered JSON; no LF
digestDomains.previousRecordSha256: SHA-256 of exact preceding canonical record line including one LF
digestDomains.wireBytes: hash exact HTTP body, complete SSE frame, or Owner WAL bytes before strict parsing; reserialization is forbidden

exactJoins.browser: independent operation nonce; exact request/response hashes, status, route family, target team/run
exactJoins.nativeFact: capture SHA, shard, sequence, and exact LF-terminated line SHA
exactJoins.opencode: raw reply, typed reply, and effect use one producer-local operation nonce; applied has exactly one effect; failed has none; allow_once maps once and reject maps reject
exactJoins.product: decision and HTTP records use one Product-local operation nonce

identityDomains: artifact manifest, executable, and module SHA-256
PID, start ticks, executable device/inode and observed executable SHA-256
controller nonce, run ID, and stack-manifest payload SHA-256
emission nonce, sequence, predecessor, and exact LF-terminated record bytes
x-contract.ownerMutationVerification: Validate mutation against exact previous and next WAL bytes; do not infer from collection sizes. Non-publishing replay/conflict/unavailable/operator-required reconciliation and delivery results are not owner-wal-published facts.
